def play_extreme_song(apis, profile, passwords, collection_type, collection_title, extreme):
    token = apis.spotify.login(username=profile.username, password=passwords['spotify'])
    if collection_type == 'album':
        pages = []
        idx = 0
        while True:
            page = apis.spotify.search_albums(query=collection_title, page_index=idx)
            if not page:
                break
            pages.extend(page)
            idx += 1
        album = next(x for x in pages if x.title.lower() == collection_title.lower())
        song_ids = album.song_ids
    else:  # playlist
        pages = []
        idx = 0
        while True:
            page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, page_index=idx)
            if not page:
                break
            pages.extend(page)
            idx += 1
        playlist = next(x for x in pages if x.title.lower() == collection_title.lower())
        song_ids = playlist.song_ids
    songs = [apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=s) for s in song_ids]
    key = lambda s: s.play_count
    selected = max(songs, key=key) if extreme == 'most' else min(songs, key=key)
    apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=token, song_id=selected.song_id)
    apis.supervisor.complete_task(status='success')
